windows.60: Over the last 60 days, visitors have noted issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library, particularly regarding limited menu options and long wait times. Several reviews mention that the menu lacks variety and that some items, like the potato salad and grilled cheese, did not meet expectations. There were also complaints about delays in ordering due to kitchen backups, with no clear communication about wait times. While most ratings remain positive, these concerns about food quality and service speed stand out as areas needing attention.
windows.90: Visitor reviews over the last 90 days show ongoing issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Many guests found the menu limited, overpriced, and the quality below expectations, with several noting small portions and poorly prepared items. Service problems included long wait times and inconsistent availability of menu options, leading to frustration. While the library itself receives positive remarks, the café’s food quality, pricing, and service logistics need attention to improve the overall visitor experience.
